card.line: Sidon was an old Phoenician port city on the Mediterranean coast, known for trade, and a place where Elijah, Jesus, and Paul each passed through.

moments.title: Elijah sent to Zarephath
moments.text: When the brook dried up, the LORD told Elijah to go to Zarephath of Sidon. A widow there shared her last flour and oil, and the jar and jug did not run out.

moments.title: A Canaanite woman's faith
moments.text: Jesus went to the district of Tyre and Sidon. A Canaanite woman begged Him for help for her daughter, and He praised her great faith and her daughter was healed.

moments.title: Jesus passes through Sidon
moments.text: Jesus left the region of Tyre and went through Sidon on His way to the Sea of Galilee and the Decapolis.

moments.title: Paul visits friends
moments.text: On the way to Rome, Paul's ship landed at Sidon. The centurion Julius let Paul visit his friends and receive their care.
